validity.researcher_notes: STANDING CONTEXT: wiki_citations.json is empty for this row (gem.wiki 403'd the harvester all run, confirmed again by my own WebFetch attempt at https://www.gem.wiki/AV22-Kot_Addu_Gas_Pipeline -> HTTP 403/Cloudflare), and all 7 [ref] units for P4102 came back MISSING_REF, so there was nothing pre-existing to re-verify -- this is fresh open-web research. The session's WebSearch tool was already at its 200/200 budget cap before I could use it on this row, and every general search engine I tried via WebFetch (Bing, DuckDuckGo/lite, Yandex, Mojeek, Ecosia, Brave, Marginalia, Startpage) was either CAPTCHA-gated, 403/429-blocked, or (Bing specifically) returned zero relevant hits for 'Kot Addu'+'SNGPL'+'gas pipeline' in any combination, falling back to unrelated 'KOT' (Kitchen Order Ticket) results -- a genuine null result, not a caching artifact (verified by re-running a control query, which returned correct, on-topic results). web.archive.org and ogra.org.pk were both unreachable/blocked to WebFetch. EXISTENCE: confirmed, and confirmed hard. SNGPL's own live, current 'Transmission System' page (What We Do > Transmission System, province-wise breakup, dated as of 30 June 2025) lists a line item named literally 'AV22 - KOT ADDU' in the Punjab section at 16-inch diameter, 69.65 km main line -- an EXACT match to GEM's recorded LengthKnown=69.65 km and Diameter=16in, reproduced identically across two independent fetches of the page. AV22 is evidently SNGPL's internal valve-station code for a point near Multan (consistent with GEM's StartLocation='Ayazabad Qasba Maral', Multan district, though the SNGPL table itself only names the station 'AV22', not the village -- I could not independently confirm the village-level location, but it is a plausible, specific place name and not contradicted by anything I found, so I am not flagging it). This SNGPL naming convention ('AV##'/'SV#'/'HQ#'/'N#'/'MP##' valve/measuring-point codes) also explains the identical-looking family of ~50 other roster rows from the same 2023-07 bulk load (P4090-P4182) -- they are not fabricated codes, they trace to SNGPL's real internal asset-naming system. CLASSIFICATION: correct -- SNGPL itself files this under 'Transmission System', not distribution/gathering. FUEL: Gas -- trivially correct (SNGPL = a natural-gas transmission utility; Kot Addu also hosts KAPCO, a large multi-fuel power plant independently confirmed via Wikipedia to run partly on natural gas, consistent with a dedicated gas feeder into the town). ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=SNGPL 100% -- confirmed; this is definitionally SNGPL's own transmission asset per SNGPL's own register. DUPLICATE check against the 63-row roster: P4104 'Dhodak-Kot Addu Gas Pipeline' (77.79km/16in) also terminates at Kot Addu with the same diameter, so I specifically checked whether P4102 and P4104 could be the same segment double-entered under two names. They are not: SNGPL's SAME table separately lists 'DHODAK - KOT ADDU' at 16in/77.79km (again an exact match to P4104's recorded spec, reproduced identically on a follow-up fetch) as a DISTINCT line item from 'AV22 - KOT ADDU' (16in/69.65km) -- two different, independently-documented supply legs into the same power-plant hub from two different directions (Dhodak field to the west/D.G.Khan side vs. the AV22 valve station near Multan). No duplicate; both rows are real and correctly distinct. SPEC: Length=69.65km/Diameter=16in match SNGPL's own current asset register exactly, to two decimal places -- as strong a spec confirmation as is available short of a second fully independent (non-SNGPL) source. STATUS: 'operating' is correct -- the line appears in SNGPL's live current-network table (dated mid-2025), not an archived/historical page. TIER NOTE (honesty on corroboration): this is a single-origin source -- SNGPL is simultaneously the row's owner/operator AND my only citation, so despite the exactness of the match I am NOT calling this 2-independent/high; it is tier=medium (one strong, authoritative, current primary source: the actual asset owner's own published register) per the confidence-tier rules, consistent with how P4090 (same source, same table, reviewed separately) was tier'd. INCIDENTAL DISCOVERY NOTE (not actioned, flagged for the record only): SNGPL's table ALSO lists 'AV22 - KOT ADDU' at 20-inch/38.01km as a SEPARATE Punjab main line (reproduced identically on both fetches) plus an apparent third AV22/AC6-area RLNG line in the 36-inch range (numbers were NOT consistent across my two fetches for that one -- 27.35km vs 23.16km, 'AV22-AC6' vs 'AC6-AV29' -- so I am not confident enough in that specific figure to report it as fact, only that a third line likely exists at this junction). Neither the 20-inch AV22-Kot Addu line nor the AC6-area RLNG line has an obvious corresponding row in the 63-pipeline roster provided. This looks like a genuine coverage gap (uncaptured segments), not something to fold into P4102 itself -- recommend a follow-up Discovery pass on the AV22/AC6/Kot Addu cluster, out of scope for this validity-only pass.

summary: P4102 (AV22-Kot Addu Gas Pipeline) CONFIRMED real and correctly classified: SNGPL's own live transmission-network breakup table lists 'AV22 - KOT ADDU' at exactly 16in/69.65km, matching GEM to two decimal places, with SNGPL also confirmed as owner and 'transmission' as the correct classification (tier=medium, single-origin -- the owner's own register, no second fully independent source found despite an extensive but blocked/exhausted search-engine effort). Duplicate check against P4104 (Dhodak-Kot Addu, same diameter) ruled out -- SNGPL's same table lists both as distinct real segments. Incidental note (not actioned): the same SNGPL table shows an uncaptured 20in AV22-Kot Addu line and a probable third AC6-area RLNG line at this junction, worth a future Discovery look. No UNRESOLVED items.
